description: Client-side script defining a Vue.js component for dynamic form group and rule management, including methods for adding/removing groups and rules, populating fields, and handling UI interactions.

classes.name: Vue
classes.description: Vue.js instance used to manage dynamic form groups and rules.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Adds a new group with default rule.

methods.name: addRule
methods.description: Adds a new rule to a specified group.

methods.name: removeRule
methods.description: Removes a rule from a specified group.

methods.name: populateFields
methods.description: Populates field options based on current DOM inputs.

methods.name: getInputs
methods.description: Retrieves input elements from the DOM for field options.

methods.name: filteredFieldOptions
methods.description: Filters available field options to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: operatorsList
methods.description: Returns list of operators based on selected field type.

methods.name: operatorMapping
methods.description: Defines operator options for different input types.

methods.name: toggleTabEvent
methods.description: Handles tab change events to update field options.

methods.name: shouldShowValue
methods.description: Determines if value input should be shown based on operator.
